learning_outcomes.text: Draw manufacturing and assembly drawings of machine parts using drawing tools.
Effectively use the computer in drawing machine manufacturing and assembly drawings.
Know the technical drawing rules related to manufacturing and assembly drawings.

syllabus_topics: Solid Works - 2D drawing commands and related applications.
Solid Works - 2D drawing commands and related applications.
Solid Works - 3D drawing commands and related applications.
Solid Works - 3D drawing commands and related applications.

Machine/Assembly Drawings: Bearing elements (Bearings, slides, ball screws, bushings).
Machine/Assembly Drawings: Bearing elements (Bearings, slides, ball screws, bushings).
